query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN sageEnrichment IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(sageEnrichment)) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as enriched
FROM achievements
WHERE clientId = 810001;
